item.title: Basket or oven-style air fryer: what should you compare?
item.description: Compare the cooking surface, the space you have, and how you unload dinner.

item.title: How much air fryer capacity do you actually need?
item.description: Start with your usual portions, not the largest number on the box.

item.title: How much cleanup and counter space should you plan for?
item.description: Picture the appliance with the drawer or door open, and the parts in your sink.

item.title: What should you ask before buying a multi-function appliance?
item.description: Choose the functions you would use weekly and check what each requires.
